headline: Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds (chest) out for year, source says
summary: Giants linebacker Tremaine Edmunds will miss the rest of the season with a torn chest muscle, a source told ESPN's Jordan Raanan. Edmunds leads the team with 50 tackles and wears the green dot to make the calls on defense.

headline: Bears TE Cole Kmet out for season after knee injury vs. Patriots
summary: Bears tight end Cole Kmet will miss the remainder of the 2026 season after he suffered a serious right knee injury during Chicago's 30-24 win over New England.

headline: Ravens' Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) unsure if he'll play
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson said he's dealing with a high ankle sprain and is unsure if he'll play this week against the Bengals, but is "heading in the right direction" after missing the past two games.

headline: Former Rams Five-Time Pro Bowl RB Lawrence McCutcheon Passes Away
summary: Longtime Rams running back Lawrence McCutcheon passed away on Friday after a battle with Parkinson’s disease, his family and the team announced. headline: 49ers WR Evans, DE Bosa, WR Samuel out vs. Atlanta; WR Kirk may return
summary: 49ers receivers Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr., and defensive end Nick Bosa are among a half dozen players who have been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

headline: Cowboys say still time to turn things around after 2-4 start
summary: Cowboys stars Dak Prescott and CeeDee Lamb express belief that there's still time for the team to turn things around despite a 2-4 start.
